params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive - Doom:}} Periodically, {{ci|Vex}} empowers her next basic ability to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and briefly {{tip|flee|fear}} enemies hit.
params.blurb2:
{{sbc|Innate - Gloom:}} Nearby enemies that {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} become marked with ''Gloom'' for a few seconds. '''Vex's''' next basic attack or basic ability hit will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{sti|cdr|reduce}} ''Doom's'' cooldown.
''{{ai|Looming Darkness|Vex}}'' will also inflict ''Gloom'', but cannot detonate it.
params.description:
{{sbc|Passive - Doom:}} Periodically, '''Vex''' empowers her next {{tip|ability|basic ability}} to {{tip|knockdown|knock down}} and {{tip|fear}} enemies hit for {{pp|0.75 to 1.5 for 4|1;6;9;13}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{pp|type=distance from '''Vex'''|60 to 99 for 11|250 to 800|key=%|formula=60% + 3.9% for every 55 units away from Vex}}. If ''{{ai|Looming Darkness 2|Vex|Looming Darkness}}'' triggers ''Doom'', enemies hit will {{tip|flee}} from the epicenter instead.
''Doom's'' {{sti|cooldown}} resets upon [[death|respawning]].
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Gloom:}} Nearby enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} that {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} will be marked with ''Gloom'' for 6 seconds. '''Vex's''' next {{tip|basic attack}}, which becomes {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}, or basic ability hit against an enemy with ''Gloom'' will detonate the mark. ''{{ai|Looming Darkness|Vex}}'' will also inflict ''Gloom'', but cannot detonate it.
params.description3: ''Gloom's'' detonation deals {{pp|40 + (150-40)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and refunds 25% of ''Doom's'' cooldown. Against non-champions, this instead deals {{pp|40 to 60 for 5|1;6;9;13;16|key=%}} damage and refunds 10% of ''Doom's'' cooldown.
params.notes:
* ''Gloom'' will mark {{ui|Rift Herald}} and {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} when they use their dashes.
* ''Gloom'' can mark {{tip|clone|clones}}, but not other {{tip|pet|pets}}.
* ''Gloom's'' mark has a very brief cooldown and refreshes on subsequent dashes or blinks nearby enemies use.
* ''Gloom's'' mark duration will refresh to {{fd|0.5}} seconds when '''Vex''' starts an attack windup against a target that has a mark which is about to expire.
* ''Gloom'' will mark enemies even if they are {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Gloom'' will mark enemies that are inside the detection radius when they blink, but will not mark those that blink inside from far away.{{bug|2}}
* ''Doom's'' cooldown starts as soon as the basic ability is cast.
* ''Doom's'' {{tip|flee|fear}} will not be removed when '''Vex''' dies, unlike any other {{tip|flee|fear}} in the game.{{bug}}
* Non-champions (e.g. {{ui|Rift Scuttler}}) are not {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by the fear-empowered ability.{{bug|2}}
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block all of ''Doom's'' effects but not ''Gloom's'' empowered attack nor mark.
* Nearby enemies that become displaced do not count for being marked by ''Gloom''.
* {{cais|Soul Unbound|Yone}} recast does not cause the caster to be marked by ''Gloom''.{{bug}}
* '''Vex's''' basic abilities use a different icon when ''Doom'' is ready:
** [[File:Vex Mistral Bolt 2.png|20px|border]] Mistral Bolt
** [[File:Vex Personal Space 2.png|20px|border]] Personal Space
** [[File:Vex Looming Darkness 2.png|20px|border]] Looming Darkness

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vex}} launches a wave of mist in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. After a short delay, the wave accelerates but also narrows.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' launches a wave of mist in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. After travelling 500 units, the wave accelerates but also narrows itself.
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** ''Mistral Bolt'' will fire from wherever '''Vex''' is at the end of the cast time, towards the originally targeted location or 1200 units in the originally targeted direction if cast beyond that.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vex}} emits a deafening scream around her, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|shield|shielding}} herself for a short time.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' emits a deafening scream around her before the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

The scream's radius is slightly increased against enemies that are {{tip|dash|dashing}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
params.description2: '''''Vex''' can move during Personal Space's cast time.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|475|Standard radius}}|{{tt|550|Enhanced radius against dashing enemies}}}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vex}} tosses her ''Shadow'' to explode at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies hit for a short time. The explosion widens based on cast distance.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' tosses her ''Shadow'' to explode at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. The explosion's radius increases based on cast distance.
params.description2: Killing an enemy with ''Looming Darkness'' refunds 10% of ''{{ai|Doom 'n Gloom|Vex|Doom's}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}, increased to 25% for champion kills.
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{pp|type = cast distance|200;200+13;200+13*2;200+13*3;200+13*4;200+13*5;200+13*6;200+13*7;300|0;X;X;X;X;X;X;X;800|formula=200 +13 per X cast distance. ''This is capped at 300 effect radius.''}}

params.blurb:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vex}} sends her ''Shadow'' in the target direction, which deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. ''Shadow'' stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, marking and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for a few seconds.
''Shadow Surge'' can be recast while the target is marked.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vex''' {{tip|dashes}} towards the marked target. Upon arrival, the mark is consumed to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target.
params.blurb3: If '''Vex''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against the marked target within a few seconds of the mark's application, she can cast ''Shadow Surge'' again within some time, repeating the effects.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vex''' sends her ''Shadow'' in the target direction, which grants {{tip|sight}} around its {{tt|trajectory|Does not see into brush or across terrain}} and deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description2: ''Shadow'' stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} to mark them for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. ''Shadow Surge'' can be recast while the target is marked.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vex''' {{tip|dashes}} towards the marked target with {{tip|displacement immunity}}. Upon arrival, she consumes their mark and deals {{as|magic damage}}.
params.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|75+150 to 175+350}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20+50}}% AP)}}}}
params.description4: If '''Vex''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against ''Shadow Surge's'' marked target within 8 seconds of its application, '''Vex''' can cast ''Shadow Surge'' again within 12 seconds at no cost after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, repeating the effects.
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* '''Vex's''' dash will track the target if they change locations.
** She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
* ''Shadow Surge'' grants sight of the area along its path for {{fd|{{tt|0.4|Estimated}}}} seconds each.
* ''Shadow Surge'' cannot be recast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, or if the target is {{tip|untargetable}}.
* ''Shadow Surge'' grants the additional cast from scoring the takedown even if the target died to the ability.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Vex''' is dashing:
** All movement spells are disabled during the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds of the dash.
